dedupe_keys.name: seaside testbed data inventory for infrastructure population and earthquake tsunami hazard

description: Seaside Testbed Data Inventory for Infrastructure, Population, and Earthquake-Tsunami Hazard is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Daniel Cox, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). This project contains datasets associated with Seaside, Oregon, a multi-hazard testbed for infrastructure resilience. Seaside is located along the Oregon coast and is subject to both seismic and tsunami hazards associated with the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ). The Seaside testbed was established as a multi-hazard testbed for the NIST Community Resilience Center of Excellence. Coverage: Seaside, Oregon. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Multiple hazards, Seismic-tsunami, Infrastructure, Social impacts, Community resilience. Published 2022-04-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
